authority.free_only_meaning: external-provider token/spend policy; owner VPS and established bridge allowed

external_source_pins.relevant_mechanism: bounded queue, explicit leaky policy, in/out/dropped counters
external_source_pins.coordination_note: A separate Trigger-6 GStreamer capture-backpressure E1 result landed concurrently at d6cb3babed82e7a74f830a9e80efaf28288e1e5a. Treat the GStreamer portion as overlapping/complementary evidence, not independent replication.

observed_properties: single canonical capture owner lease per source/generation
FrameRef binds source_generation, capture_owner_id, lease_id, sequence, monotonic capture time, frame SHA-256, payload size and provenance refs
policy bounds max_frames_per_source, max_frame_age_ns and max_read_window_frames
read windows expose missed_before_sequence rather than pretending evicted history is still present
source snapshots expose retained frame IDs, oldest/newest sequence and exact evicted_frame_count
state is explicitly RAM-only/nonpersistent and has no world/effect/completion authority
canonical_wp709_mapping.missing_stronger_history_property: The canonical broker does not currently expose a cumulative cryptographic commitment over every accepted FrameRef/event after old refs are evicted. It preserves bounded current state, sequences, per-frame hashes and aggregate eviction count, but not an independently anchored complete-history commitment.

parallel_retina_mapping.useful_donor_property: The parallel retina_capture_broker.py adds a prior-state SHA-256 plus current-frame SHA-256 rolling commitment while keeping live state bounded.
parallel_retina_mapping.authority_problem: That module is not the accepted WP709 mutation authority and cannot be used as the basis for canonical architecture credit. Its post-acceptance evolution is evidence of duplicate-source drift, not promotion.
parallel_retina_mapping.semantic_limit: A rolling predecessor digest is a cumulative commitment only. If earlier states/checkpoints are discarded, it does not by itself provide arbitrary historical inclusion proofs or a self-contained verifiable append-only log.

imports_rejected_now: BLAKE3 dependency solely for broker history commitment
GStreamer dependency solely for queue/drop policy
architecture_decision.reason: The accepted canonical broker already contains stronger source-generation, lease, age-bound, missed-window and per-frame provenance semantics. External frameworks would add dependency/state complexity without satisfying a current acceptance requirement that the broker itself prove arbitrary historical inclusion. The duplicate broker's useful rolling-hash idea can be distilled later without preserving a second implementation authority.

candidate_successor_delta_if_required.name: CANONICAL_CAPTURE_HISTORY_COMMITMENT
minimal_fields: explicit history_proof_available=false unless external checkpoints exist
candidate_successor_delta_if_required.update_input: domain-separated canonical event encoding of prior commitment + source_id + source_generation + accepted FrameRef SHA-256 + sequence + eviction outcome
candidate_successor_delta_if_required.persistence_boundary: Broker remains RAM-only. Any durable checkpoint belongs in the existing canonical state/audit/receipt plane, not in a new broker database.
candidate_successor_delta_if_required.restart_boundary: Audit continuity across restart must be anchored by an externally persisted checkpoint; otherwise continuity is UNKNOWN, not inferred.

counterhypotheses.statement: Per-frame hashes + source_sequence + evicted_frame_count are already sufficient for all practical Perception Fabric debugging, so a cumulative commitment would add complexity without actionable evidence gain.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Find a concrete acceptance/recovery/audit case that cannot be resolved from canonical snapshots, frame receipts and existing external journals. If none exists, do not add the commitment.

counterhypotheses.statement: A Merkle compact-range log is justified because arbitrary historical inclusion proofs will become a hard product requirement.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Require an explicit accepted requirement for independent inclusion/consistency proofs and benchmark proof-state/storage/latency against a simple checkpointed hash chain before E5 promotion.

falsifiers_for_any_successor: reordering two accepted FrameRef events must change the history commitment
omitting one accepted FrameRef must change the history commitment
cross-source or cross-generation replay must fail closed or yield a different domain-separated commitment
eviction must not erase cumulative commitment state
a persisted checkpoint at sequence N plus canonical receipts N+1..M must deterministically reproduce the sequence-M commitment
missing checkpoint after restart must not be reported as verified continuous history
no new broker database or second capture ownership authority may be created

coordination.do_not_modify: Current accepted WP709 source without a successor mutation authority
coordination.reason_not_e5: No F2 ablation or target-runtime evidence demonstrates that stronger history commitment improves an accepted requirement enough to justify implementation now.

next_exact_action: Consume the WP709 duplicate-authority reconciliation first. Only if a concrete durable-audit requirement remains after that reconciliation, claim a new E3/E4 objective to test a minimal domain-separated SHA-256 history commitment on the canonical broker successor against no-commitment baseline; do not import Merkle/BLAKE3/GStreamer merely for this feature.
